NEWS 2026-11-18 Mint (GTA 6 pre-orders hit 17 million, generate $1.65 billion ahead of launch; what does the $10):
Rockstar Games' highly anticipated “Grand Theft Auto VI” (GTA 6) is on course to become the biggest entertainment launch ever, with pre-orders reportedly generating an estimated $1.65 billion in revenue ahead of its November 19 release.
According to estimates published by market intelligence firm Sensor Tower on Wednesday, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) has sold approximately 17.07 million units through pre-orders.
The figure could rise to $2 billion by the time the game launches, potentially setting a new record for opening-day entertainment revenue.
The firm's estimates indicate that PlayStation accounts for approximately 75% of pre-orders, while the remaining 25% are for Microsoft's Xbox consoles.
The scale of the expected launch becomes clearer when compared with its predecessor. GTA 5, released in 2013, took just three days to generate $1 billion in sales.
The upcoming release marks the franchise's first instalment in more than 13 years, building on the enormous commercial success of GTA 5, which has sold more than 230 million copies worldwide.
Rockstar is offering GTA 6 in two editions, with different price points and additional content.
The Standard Edition is priced at $80, while the Ultimate Edition costs $100 and includes additional in-game features and bonuses.
Players who purchase the Standard Edition can also upgrade to the Ultimate Edition through the PlayStation or Microsoft stores after redeeming their Standard Edition code.
The price of the game comes amid rising costs for gaming hardware. Players purchasing new PlayStation or Xbox consoles may have to spend between $599 and $899, adding to the overall cost of accessing the latest instalment.
Both editions will be released on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
The $100 Ultimate Edition includes the base game and an additional upgrade package featuring vehicles, weapons, customisation options, clothing and in-game locations.
Among the bonuses are the '95 Grotti Cheetah, Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers, personalised weapon variants, Jason's Safehouse Vehicles and the '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy.
The package also includes several in-game businesses and locations, including the Rideout Customs Mod Shop, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305 Clothing Store, Electric Fang Tattoo Parlor and One-Eyed Willie's Mod Shop.
Other additions include the Shitzu Squalo, Ganado Retro Build, Goodtime Gear, PTT Youngin$ Compound and Classic Car Collection.
The Ultimate Edition bonuses are spread across Jason and Lucia's storyline, with additional items becoming available as players progress through different chapters.
GTA 6 will launch on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game was initially scheduled for a late 2025 release but was subsequently delayed.
The latest instalment returns to Vice City, Rockstar's fictionalised version of Miami, but expands the setting to Leonida, a fictional state inspired by Florida.

Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following Grand Theft Auto V (2013), and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, and in the fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Players are able to freely roam Leonida's open world.
Preliminary work began in 2014 following the release of Grand Theft Auto V, with principal production starting after the launch of Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018. Rockstar's global development teams more than doubled since Red Dead Redemption 2. Miami and its surrounding areas were extensively researched for the game's world, which parodies 2020s American culture. The protagonists' dynamic is inspired by the notorious outlaw duo Bonnie and Clyde, and the non-player characters (NPCs) were written to ensure players experience different areas of Vice City.
Following years of speculation and anticipation, Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development. That September, footage from unfinished versions was leaked. Grand Theft Auto VI was formally revealed in December 2023. It became the most preordered video game of all time, with estimated sales exceeding 17 million digital copies, generating over $1.6 billion in revenue prior to launch. Following two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it was released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S to universal critical acclaim. It ties with[disputed – discuss] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) to become the highest-rated video game on Metacritic, and it is the only game from the 21st century to achieve an overall score of 99.
Gameplay
Grand Theft Auto VI is a single-player, action-adventure game set within an open world played from a third-person view as either Jason Duval or Lucia Caminos. Players can choose to fight non-player characters (NPCs), steal vehicles, rob establishments or get into high-speed chases with the police.[1][2][3] When roaming freely, players have several options for activities such as skydiving, wrestling, basketball, exercising, kayaking and scuba diving.[4][5][6][7]
Throughout the game, players can gain or lose weight—a returning feature from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas—as both characters, and if the player stays awake as either character for days on end, it will become visible on their faces.[8] The game has a "Criminal Profile" rating system that tracks each player character's reputation based on their actions, similar to the honour system previously used in Red Dead Redemption 2.[9] This system is not meant to portray Lucia and Jason as "do-gooders", but will track whether each character keeps their crimes professional or commits unnecessary violence with in-game consequences that reflect their reputation.[10]

SOURCE rockpapershotgun.com (GTA 6 release time, launch date, preload and file size):
GTA 6 is almost here. The next Grand Theft Auto is arguably the most anticipated game of all time, and we're now just hours away from returning to Vice City.
I remember being there for the midnight launch of GTA 4, and booking the day off work to play GTA 5, but nothing comes close to the sky-high excitement surrounding GTA 6. If you can't wait to play it and you're wondering when does GTA 6 come out, then we've rounded up everything you need to know. We've got details on the GTA 6 release time and the New Zealand trick, plus much more.
On this page:
GTA 6 release time and date
Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 will launch at midnight local time on Thursday 19th, November 2026. Unlike some games which launch at different times in regions around the world, the Grand Theft Auto makers said they had adopted "a rolling midnight launch by country". So you'll just need to wait for 12am on release day for the game to unlock in your region on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
There are a few caveats to all this. Due to the way the game is being rolled out, GTA 6 will launch in some countries earlier than others. It will be playable in New Zealand first, with gamers there getting to play it six hours ahead of those on the US East Coast, and for half a day before GTA 6 hits Europe.
If you want to go into GTA 6 without any spoilers, just be aware there will be people that have a headstart.
Is there GTA 6 early access?
GTA 6 doesn't have early access, so there is no official way you can play it early. Due to the way the game is being rolled out, you may be wondering if you'll be able to play GTA 6 early if you change your console's settings so it looks like you're in New Zealand. It is a method that has worked with other high-profile launches. If this is something you're considering, we've got this guide on the GTA 6 New Zealand trick to help you out.
GTA 6 free codes giveaway
If you haven't purchased GTA 6 yet, you can save some money thanks to Twitch and Kick. The streaming giants will be giving away free GTA 6 codes at launch to viewers. Kick alone is giving away 10,000 GTA 6 codes, while Twitch said they will be doing daily code drops from launch till the end of November. Of course, getting a GTA 6 code via this way isn't guaranteed, and you could simply get some of the other freebies that are available. If this sounds like something you want to try out, check out our page on how to get free GTA 6 codes from Twitch and Kick launch streams.
How to preload GTA 6
The GTA 6 preload began last week. To preload GTA 6, you need to have pre-ordered the game ahead of launch. Whether you pre-ordered digitally or physically, you will be able to install the game to your PS5 or Xbox Series X|S right now. That's because the physical version just comes with a code in a box, and it began shipping prior to the game's release date.
If you already pre-ordered digitally, you'll just need to go to the GTA 6 listing on the PlayStation Store or your Xbox's store and choose to install the game. If you bought the physical version instead, you'll need to redeem the code you received first.
It's best to get ready and preload GTA 6 now if you want to jump into Vice City as soon as the game unlocks. You may also need to free up some space on your console, given how hefty the file size is.

Is GTA 6 out? Yes. Grand Theft Auto VI released on Thursday 19 November 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, almost three years after its first trailer and after two delays. Digital copies unlock at midnight local time in the country of your PlayStation or Xbox account, so the evening of 18 November is already launch night in the western United States. If the game still shows as locked, check the hour for your region below.

When did GTA 6 come out?
On Thursday 19 November 2026, at midnight local time for digital copies, which means the last hours of 18 November for the western United States and the first minutes of 19 November for Europe and the United Kingdom. It is the date Rockstar set on 6 November 2025, and it held.
What time does GTA 6 unlock in my region?
The PlayStation Store lists a release timestamp per country: digital copies unlock at midnight on 19 November in the store's own time zone, so New Zealand goes first and Mexico goes last, 19 hours later. Xbox follows the same convention. The hour depends on the country of your PlayStation or Xbox account, not on the clock of your console.
| Region | Local unlock | In UTC | 
|---|---|---|
| New Zealand | 19 Nov, 12:00 am NZDT | 18 Nov, 11:00 UTC | 
| Australia (Sydney; Perth 9 pm on 18 Nov) | 19 Nov, 12:00 am AEDT | 18 Nov, 13:00 UTC | 
| Japan, South Korea | 19 Nov, 12:00 am JST | 18 Nov, 15:00 UTC | 
| India | 19 Nov, 12:00 am IST | 18 Nov, 18:30 UTC | 
| France, Germany, Spain, Italy and the CET zone | 19 Nov, 12:00 am CET | 18 Nov, 23:00 UTC | 
| United Kingdom, Ireland, Portugal | 19 Nov, 12:00 am GMT | 19 Nov, 00:00 UTC | 
| Brazil (São Paulo) | 19 Nov, 12:00 am BRT | 19 Nov, 03:00 UTC | 
| United States, Canada (New York; Los Angeles 9 pm on 18 Nov) | 19 Nov, 12:00 am ET | 19 Nov, 05:00 UTC | 
| Mexico, Central America | 19 Nov, 12:00 am CST | 19 Nov, 06:00 UTC | 
The Xbox Store now lists the same unlock timestamps as the PlayStation Store: 11:00 UTC on 18 November for New Zealand, 23:00 UTC for France and 05:00 UTC on 19 November for the United States. The full list of 63 territories and the step-by-step New Zealand trick are in our GTA 6 release times guide; the GTA 6 hub gathers everything confirmed so far.
GTA 6 preload and download
Preloading opened on 10 November for digital pre-orders. If you did not preload, plan for the full download on launch night, up to 212 GB depending on the console; Rockstar has not said whether a launch update adds to it. There is no disc: boxed copies, on sale since 12 November, contain a download code, so every copy is downloaded. Drive and space rules for each console are in our GTA 6 file size guide.
Was GTA 6 delayed?
Twice before release. Announced for 2025, it moved to 26 May 2026, then to 19 November 2026. After that second announcement, on 6 November 2025, the date held: pre-orders opened, the editions were priced, the Extended Look aired on schedule, the Launch Trailer followed on 15 October and the game came out on the day.
| Date | What happened | 
|---|---|
| 4 December 2023 | Trailer 1: Rockstar announces GTA 6 for 2025, later narrowed to autumn 2025. | 
| 2 May 2025 | First delay: the release moves to 26 May 2026. | 
| 6 November 2025 | Second delay: the release moves to 19 November 2026, the date it came out. |
